parts.label: Part 3
parts.article:
Alice: Tim, the lectures we've been attending recently have been very informative. I love the diversity of the information we're learning! It gives a broad overall picture of the subject.

Tim: True, Alice, and it's useful to have a mentor help us get the most out of our studies. I admit, I wasn't particularly confident before starting this course. I felt my skills were not at the level required to succeed.

Alice: I felt the same way, but with help from Mr. Jarvis, I'm growing in self-confidence and ability every day. I'm grateful he has the time to spend one-on-one with the students.

Tim: Yeah, I improved a lot. I would like him to be able to give us more information on other subjects however, he does give a very narrow view of economics. And I would like some advice on how to prepare for our seminars. I'm never sure what to expect.

Alice: I'm focusing on passing my exams at the moment. Mr. Jarvis has been coaching me in this respect. He saw I was worried and offered to help.

Tim: I'm grateful for his help in this respect too. I'll think about what to study next year once I pass. I'm not sure what I should do with my life. I can't see myself pursuing a career in economics.

Alice: You have many skills that could be useful in several different fields. You've talked with the tutor about it previously, haven't you?

Tim: Not regarding my career. I did discuss with him some options for next semester, which course I might choose. He had some great advice. He suggested that I should continue studying in this field for now. I wonder if he might help me with the experiments I need to conduct. I should ask him.

Alice: Great idea.

Tim: How do you feel about the essays we've been required to write?

Alice: I thought it can be difficult than it is actually but I'm just able to deal with it. There are so many assignments to complete. If they were any harder I don't think I could manage.

Tim: I feel the same way. I was talking with John yesterday and he believes the level of difficulty for our assignments could be higher, that they are too basic for him.

Alice: I'm happy for him. I think this subject poses many challenges though.

Tim: Why do you say that? Your mathematical skills are very high. I heard you aced all your exams throughout high school.

Alice: At first the subject didn't pique my interest. I've had no previous experience in economics so this is all new ground for me.

Tim: Well, you seem to be succeeding despite your misgivings. My one concern is that we don’t have the opportunity to put the theory we’re learning to any practical use. We learn many formulas and strategies, but with no practical application it feels like we are wasting our time.

Alice: I don’t agree. I feel that the project we worked on last month was very practical. We had the chance to test our skills and ascertain the areas we need to improve.

Tim: I will say that this course is giving us many opportunities to expand our networks which will be of benefit when we have graduated and are seeking employment.

Alice: Yes, I’ve had the opportunity to meet many successful economists and businessmen, and hear how they raise to their positions through hard work and dedication. This has been of great value. Do you feel we have had enough opportunities to experience what it is like to work in a large organization?

Tim: At first I believe that to be the case. Now I’m not so sure.

Alice: I think we’ve been given ample opportunities first through the work placement program, and then by means of the excursions we’ve taken to some of the most prominent financial institutions in the country. I feel though that through the course we haven’t put enough emphasis on communication.

Tim: Communication is vital in the workplace, especially in an environment where one mistake can have serious consequences. But I believe we've been taught the necessary skills. Our lecture yesterday covered this topic thoroughly.

Alice: You mentioned you may not continue with economics. Is it perhaps because you believe we haven’t been shown the career possibilities in this field?

Tim: No, our classes with Ms Hathaway have been beneficial in showing the possibilities. It seems the teachers here would like us all to continue in our study. They take every opportunity to assist us in identifying what specific career to pursue.

Alice: I agree. They have made it very clear what our options are, which I’m thankful for.

questions.question: Which THREE kinds of help did both Tim and Alice get from their mentor?

analyses.content: Tim 承认开始时没信心，Alice 说她感觉一样，但现在两人都表示在导师帮助下信心提升了（Tim 说 "True", Alice 说 "growing in self-confidence"）。

Tim: True, Alice, and it's useful to have a mentor help us get the most out of our studies. I admit, I wasn't particularly confident before starting this course. I felt my skills were not at the level required to succeed. Alice: I felt the same way, but with help from Mr. Jarvis, I'm growing in self-confidence and ability every day.
你可能听到 Tim 说 "I wasn't particularly confident" 就以为他没信心，但他后面接了 "True... and it's useful to have a mentor help us"，表明这是导师帮助改善的地方。

questions.question: Which THREE kinds of help did both Tim and Alice get from their mentor?

analyses.content: Alice: I'm focusing on passing my exams at the moment. Mr. Jarvis has been coaching me in this respect. He saw I was worried and offered to help. Tim: I'm grateful for his help in this respect too.
不要因为 Alice 先提出来就以为只有她受益，一定要往后多听一句 Tim 的回应 "in this respect too"。
Alice 明确说导师正在辅导她通过考试（coaching me），Tim 紧接着说在这方面也很感激导师的帮助（help in this respect too），两人都得到了帮助。

questions.question: Which THREE kinds of help did both Tim and Alice get from their mentor?

analyses.content: Tim: Not regarding my career. I did discuss with him some options for next semester, which course I might choose. He had some great advice. He suggested that I should continue studying in this field for now. ... Alice: Great idea.
题目问的是 mentor 提供了哪种帮助，虽然 Tim 说还没讨论“职业（career）”，但他明确说了讨论了“下学期的课程选择”。
Tim 提到他和导师讨论了下学期的选课（options for next semester, which course I might choose），导师给了很好的建议，Alice 对此表示赞同（Great idea）。

questions.question: What do they think about the essay writing?

analyses.content: Alice: I thought it can be difficult than it is actually but I'm just able to deal with it. There are so many assignments to complete. If they were any harder I don't think I could manage. Tim: I feel the same way.
A选项（比预期简单）是干扰项，因为 Alice 虽然说了 "I thought it can be difficult..."（语法略怪），但核心落在 "just able to deal with it"（勉强应付），且 Tim 提到另一位同学 John 觉得简单，但这反衬出 Tim 和 Alice 觉得并不简单。
Alice 觉得作业很多，刚好能应付得来（just able to deal with it），如果再难一点就搞不定了，说明难度正是她能承受的极限，即符合预期的难度水平；Tim 也觉得 "feel the same way"。

questions.question: Why does Alice think it is difficult to learn economics?

analyses.content: Tim: Why do you say that? Your mathematical skills are very high. I heard you aced all your exams throughout high school. Alice: At first the subject didn't pique my interest. I've had no previous experience in economics so this is all new ground for me.
她确实提到了 "didn't pique my interest"（C选项），但那是“起初”的情况，并不是她现在觉得难的原因，难的核心原因是“零基础”。
Alice 直说以前从未学过经济学（no previous experience），这对她来说全是新领域（all new ground），所以觉得难。

analyses.content: Tim 抱怨没有机会将理论付诸实践（no practical application），但 Alice 说 "I don't agree"（我不同意），她觉得上个月的项目很实用。

Tim: ...My one concern is that we don’t have the opportunity to put the theory we’re learning to any practical use... Alice: I don’t agree. I feel that the project we worked on last month was very practical.
听到 Tim 说 "put the theory..." 别急着选，要听完他的态度是 "concern... don't have"，是否定态度，而 Alice 是肯定态度。

Tim: I will say that this course is giving us many opportunities to expand our networks which will be of benefit when we have graduated... Alice: Yes, I’ve had the opportunity to meet many successful economists and businessmen...
两人对话衔接非常顺畅，Alice 用 "Yes" 开头直接附和了 Tim 的观点，没有反转。
Tim 说课程给了很多拓展人脉（expand our networks）的机会，Alice 紧接着说 "Yes"，并举例说见到了很多成功的经济学家。

questions.question: have experience of working in large organizations

analyses.content: Alice: Do you feel we have had enough opportunities to experience what it is like to work in a large organization? Tim: At first I believe that to be the case. Now I’m not so sure. Alice: I think we’ve been given ample opportunities first through the work placement program...
Tim 的回答 "At first I believe... Now I’m not so sure" 是典型的雅思否定套路，最终态度是否定的，只有 Alice 坚持肯定。
Alice 问是否体验了大公司的工作环境，Tim 表示虽然起初相信有，但现在 "not so sure"（不确定/否定），而 Alice 坚持认为有充足机会（ample opportunities）。

Alice: ...I feel though that through the course we haven’t put enough emphasis on communication. Tim: Communication is vital... But I believe we've been taught the necessary skills. Our lecture yesterday covered this topic thoroughly.
注意转折词 "But"，Tim 在这里完全站在了 Alice 的对立面，认为沟通技能已经教得很全面了。
Alice 抱怨课程对沟通（communication）强调不够，但 Tim 反驳说 "But I believe we've been taught the necessary skills"（我相信教了必要的技能）。
Tim: ...They take every opportunity to assist us in identifying what specific career to pursue. Alice: I agree. They have made it very clear what our options are, which I’m thankful for.
前面 Tim 提到自己没想好做什么，可能会干扰你，但这里讨论的是“课程/老师是否提供了帮助”，这方面两人都认可老师提供了帮助。
Tim 说老师们都在帮大家确定职业方向（identifying what specific career to pursue），Alice 说 "I agree"（我同意），确认老师讲清了选项。
